verses.text: Some of whom were disobedient in the days of Noah, while the long-suffering of God waited, while the ark was preparing, wherein few, that is, eight souls were saved by water.

title: JST, 1 Peter 3:20. Compare 1 Peter 3:20 Some of the spirits in prison were unrighteous in the days of Noah.
